description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkDirectiveParser in the OpenClawKit project. It verifies parsing of directive JSON strings and handling of various edge cases within the parser.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveTests
classes.description: A test case class that includes multiple unit tests for the TalkDirectiveParser, checking parsing correctness, handling of non-directive lines, extended options, and unknown keys.

methods.name: testParsesDirectiveAndStripsLine
methods.description: Verifies that a JSON directive line is correctly parsed and the stripped text is as expected.

methods.name: testIgnoresNonDirective
methods.description: Checks that non-directive text remains unparsed and is returned as is.

methods.name: testKeepsDirectiveLineIfNoRecognizedFields
methods.description: Ensures that directives with unknown fields do not produce a directive object.

methods.name: testParsesExtendedOptions
methods.description: Validates parsing of directives with extended options like voice_id, model_id, rate, etc.

methods.name: testSkipsLeadingEmptyLinesWhenParsingDirective
methods.description: Ensures that leading empty lines are ignored and parsing starts at the first directive.

methods.name: testTracksUnknownKeys
methods.description: Checks that unknown keys in the directive are tracked separately.
